name: Ke-Wen Kong
evidence: Correct person located but no address exists in reachable sources. Appears as 'Kewen Kong' in the LLM-GLOBE author list, confirmed verbatim from the benchmark repo README at raw.githubusercontent.com/raovish6/LLM-GLOBE (free fetch). Affiliation anchor established: Columbia CC'23 (comparative literature and Italian studies, ICLS concentrator, President of the Hong Kong Students and Scholars Society), 2024 Schwarzman Scholar at Tsinghua - the Schwarzman/Tsinghua cohort is the shared affiliation with rows 195 and 196. Two queries (shared-paper query for all three LLM-GLOBE rows; his name + Amanda Hu + Schwarzman/Tsinghua + email) returned biography pages (icls.columbia.edu, college.columbia.edu) but no email address in the output, and those pages could not be opened - university domains are egress-blocked. arXiv, ar5iv and the lacuna mirror likewise blocked. No candidate address surfaced.
